description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to poll creation parameters, including shared and Telegram-specific options, parameter definitions, and utility functions for handling poll parameters.

methods.name: readPollParamRaw
methods.description: Reads a poll parameter value from a record using snake case conversion.

methods.name: resolveTelegramPollVisibility
methods.description: Determines the visibility of a Telegram poll based on 'pollAnonymous' and 'pollPublic' flags.

methods.name: hasPollCreationParams
methods.description: Checks if the given parameters object contains any valid poll creation parameters.
